items.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
items.title_zh: Fisher-R1：训练 LLM 智能体进行可靠的假设检验
items.summary: The authors introduce P-Bench, a 425-task benchmark for open-ended hypothesis testing across economics, biology and medicine, and Fisher-R1, an open-weight agent trained with reinforcement learning on verified statistical rewards. Fisher-R1-14B achieves a 21% average relative improvement in single-trial success over DeepSeek-V4-Pro, with gains up to 26% on the hardest tasks.

items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.title_zh: 腾讯云 Agent Memory：团队级 AI 智能体记忆中枢
items.summary: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents that turns conversations, documents and code into four reusable assets: Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki and Code-Graph, with governance and sharing. The project is hosted on GitHub under Tencent Cloud.

items.title: Towards Researcher Agents for Knowledge-Graph Question Answering
items.title_zh: 面向知识图谱问答的研究型智能体
items.summary: The paper presents an agentic text-to-SPARQL system whose researcher agent proposes and tests changes to its own prompts, rules and tool-orchestration code after each validation round. Evolving nine versions on DBpedia reached 0.22 overall accuracy on the 2025 validation set, with basic graph pattern predicate selection identified as the main bottleneck.

items.title: Who Verifies the Benchmark? Decentralizing Trust in Large Language Model Evaluation
items.title_zh: 谁来验证基准？去中心化大语言模型评测中的信任
items.summary: The study measures identity-aware bias in seven LLM judges scoring anonymous versus identity-disclosed answers, finding small effects on factual questions and large shifts on geopolitically sensitive topics. It also proposes a blockchain-based commit-reveal protocol using Autonomous Economic Agents to create a tamper-evident audit trail for evaluations.

items.title: Blast Radius
items.title_zh: Blast Radius：面向智能体编码的可逆上下文驱逐与预测式记忆管理
items.summary: Blast Radius is a predictive memory-management layer that estimates an incoming prompt's reach across coupled context and code channels and supports reversible eviction of dead context by archiving it verbatim. Across seven OpenAI models it reduced token consumption by 17-26% while remaining byte-exact reversible and achieving the lowest overflow rate among tested policies.

items.title: When the Judge Should Not Decide: Evidence-Locked, Non-Compensatory Selection Bounds LLM-Judge Failure in Reasoning Pipelines
items.title_zh: 当评审不应裁决：证据锁定、非补偿式选择如何限制推理流程中的 LLM 评审失败
items.summary: The paper shows that an unconstrained DeepSeek-R1-7B judge adds little over majority vote and can be 10 points worse on a confirmation split, then places the same judge inside Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair. The rule reaches 58.2% on GSM8K and 17.33 EM on HotpotQA without changing the judge, candidates or budget.

items.title: CliniCARE-Bench: Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR
items.title_zh: CliniCARE-Bench：电子病历医疗推理的临床校准审计基准
items.summary: CliniCARE-Bench evaluates clinical agents on 750 patient-specific cases derived from MIMIC-IV, scoring verdict accuracy plus evidence and policy grounding, process adherence, calibrated abstention and efficiency. Across 16 agentic systems four-way accuracy spans 65.3-76.1%, but defect-free accuracy is 4.8-14.8 points lower.

items.title: Contextual Value Alignment via Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
items.title_zh: 通过多层组合融合实现情境化价值对齐
items.summary: MCF-CVA instantiates multiple moral agents, expands their outputs combinatorially through score and rank aggregation, then reduces them back to the same number of agents across layers. The authors report that the expansion-and-reduction framework outperforms single-agent, multi-agent single-layer and previous aggregation baselines.

items.title: huangruiteng/loopx
items.title_zh: loopx：面向长期运行 AI 智能体团队的循环工程内核
items.summary: loopx is a lightweight loop-engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams, with durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake and executable todos. It is designed to work across Codex, Claude Code and other coding agents.
